description: List the 44 titles of the Colorado Revised Statutes with their official names — Title 18 is the Criminal Code, Title 42 is Vehicles and Traffic, Title 38 is Property, and so on. Keyless. Use when you know the subject but not the title number, before calling co_statute or co_search.
